My running total is an estimate; how double-hyphen words are counted may shift the measured result.
summary: I removed whole optional sentences across the chapter, mainly from the class portrait, the Virginian digressions, the German-faith background, the writing self-assessment and the Class Day setting. All eight protected excerpts and every essential beat remain. No bridge text was added. My own estimate puts the revision close to 2900 words, but it has not been measured.
